newsitem.title: UK: Rentokil shares slip ahead of year results.
newsitem.headline: Rentokil shares slip ahead of year results.

text.p: Shares in British pest control, security and business services group Rentokil Initial Plc slipped on Monday as nervousness ahead of its results announcement on Tuesday surfaced, traders said.
Rentokil shares were down 6-1/2 pence to 447 pence at 1226 GMT, just above a low of 445 pence.
"The results are due on Tuesday and there's a bit of nervousness in the market," one analyst said.
Rentokil reports full year results on Tuesday and pretax profits are expected to be between 317-335 million stg, up from 214.5 million stg previously.
Analysts are expecting it to pay out a dividend of around five pence, up from 4.2 pence a year ago.
